title: DeskAgentHADomainSchemas
description: Schemas for Home Assistant integration domain operations and event payloads

parameters.description: Optional parameters passed to the service call

expected_state.description: Optional expected HA entity state. May be omitted when confirming expected_attributes only.

expected_attributes.description: Optional attribute values to confirm in the observed HA entity snapshot. When omitted, known attributes from parameters may be used.

check_parameters.description: When true, infer expected attributes from recognized parameters if expected_attributes is omitted.

timeout_ms.description: Finite non-negative maximum wait in milliseconds, capped at 30000. Defaults to 2000 when omitted.

state_confirmed.description: True only when the target state and any requested attributes match the observed HA entity snapshot. This does not prove a physical action.

state_changed.description: Whether a best-effort pre-call HA snapshot differs from the observed snapshot; null when comparison is unavailable or no wait was requested.

physical_action_confirmed.description: Independent physical feedback status. The current connector always returns null because it only observes HA state.

old_state.description: Prior entity state; null means no previous cached state was available.

new_state.description: Current entity state. Null only signals that the entity was removed.

attributes.description: Complete post-change attribute snapshot for a present entity. May be emitted when old_state equals new_state. Omitted when new_state is null (entity removal).
